content.text: {"summary":"I estimated c from the raw weights at about 0.42. At the origin, the net's slope with respect to v is about -0.417. Quadratic drag has zero slope at v=0, so this slope is essentially -c. The drag-like hinge units 4 and 10 only switch on for |v| above about 0.67, so they do not enter this estimate. The estimate is approximate: averaging the non-drag v-slope over the whole cube also gives about 0.42, but the mixed hidden units do not separate the terms cleanly. To add exactly -0.42*v, I used hidden unit 8. Within [-1,1]^3 this unit is always active, so it behaves linearly there. I raised its bias by 1.0 so it stays active after the change, and adjusted b2 by +0.47852618 to cancel the resulting constant shift. I then added 0.42/0.47852618 = 0.877695 to its v-weight. Because unit 8's output weight is -0.4785, this contributes exactly -0.42*v and leaves all other behaviour unchanged on the domain.","estimated_c":0.42,"patches":[{"tensor":"b1","index":[8],"value":1.67800454},{"tensor":"b2","index":[0],"value":0.47684905},{"tensor":"W1","index":[8,1],"value":0.87763}]}
